title: Why do you get dizzy after squats? 😵‍💫
caption:
Holding your breath on heavy reps squeezes the veins, less blood gets back to your heart, and when you stand and breathe out your blood pressure dips for a moment. Breathe between reps and stand still for a few seconds. Ever seen stars after a set? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Why Does This Happen? #14
first_comment: Squats so heavy I saw my ancestors 👀 Who else?
